item.title: Minutes of the Transaction and Post-trade Reporting Harmonisation Taskforce - July 2026
item.source: Bank of England, central bank news feed
item.opening: The Transaction and Post-trade Reporting Harmonisation Taskforce, through its three working groups, will help inform the design of the Bank and FCA’s long-term approach to harmonising UK MiFIR, UK EMIR and UK SFTR reporting requirements
